A.notes: Full-height flex layout keeps the composer truly pinned under a flexible scroll area with three bubbles and a send event.

B.notes: Clean bubbles and composer with a send label, but the composer just follows a max-height scroll area rather than being pinned.

A.notes: All fields, delivery options labelled with their prices, and a computed summary, though the check messages are generic.

B.notes: Well-structured with specific check messages and a separator before the total, but the delivery options drop the free/$9.90 pricing.

A.notes: All fields with email and required/500-char checks, plus helpful placeholders and a card description.

B.notes: Same complete structure and validation, slightly plainer without placeholders.

A.notes: Header, three stat tiles and a bound five-row orders table in a card; refunds-down tone is reasonably success.

B.notes: Equivalent tiles and bound table with a caption.

A.notes: Idiomatic EmptyState with folder icon, title, sentence and create action.
Breadcrumb with navigation, search wired to an event, six-file table with a row menu that emits Rename/Delete for the file.

B.notes: Search filters the table client-side, but the row action menu has no handler so Rename/Delete do nothing.

A.notes: Covers everything asked (header action, five rows with avatar, message, time, New badge on the first two), though the visibility uses a roundabout cond(if/then/else) where a direct binding would do.

B.notes: Covers everything asked with a direct visible=$unread binding and a Card wrapper, but the sender subtitle repeats the name already in each message.

A.notes: Covers title, badges, tabs, description, assignee and three events, but the Activity tab is a bare Section of rows rather than a list.

B.notes: Badges, tabs with Details and Activity cards, assignee row with avatar, and a divided timeline list.

A.notes: Three tinted columns with counts and card rows with avatars, but counts and tasks are hard-coded.

B.notes: Columns as cards with counts computed from bound task lists rendered by a shared template.

A.notes: Required and email checks, remember checkbox, submit button and forgot link.

B.notes: Same complete form with a welcoming card description and blur validation.

A.notes: Centered now-playing card with labelled controls, a play toggle that updates state, progress with time text and a pressable four-track queue.

B.notes: Complete player and queue, but the icon-only buttons lack labels and play/pause only fires an event.

A.notes: Toggle, three cards with taglines, four features, highlighted Pro and buttons, but prices ignore the billing toggle and all read 'per user'.

B.notes: Same complete layout with prices that react to the monthly/yearly toggle and per-user shown on Team.

A.notes: Search with event above a responsive grid of four templated product cards with image, price, rating and add-to-cart.

B.notes: Equivalent responsive templated grid with an image fallback.

A.notes: Prefilled bound form with avatar bound to the name, change-photo action, all fields and Save/Cancel.

B.notes: Same prefilled form in a card with a searchable timezone select and a required email.

A.notes: Correct sections and controls, but the form has no submit handler, so Save does nothing.

B.notes: Carded sections with described switches, a value-showing slider and a save event carrying all settings.

A.notes: All fields and length checks in a card, but a 'required' check on a boolean may not enforce that the terms box is checked.

B.notes: Enforces the terms checkbox with eq(agree, true), though the checkbox and button sit outside the field stack.

A.notes: Add input and button, four tasks with checkbox and delete, and a footer built from a separate static count.

B.notes: Same features with a separator before a hard-coded 'tasks left' string footer.
